root_cause.text: Fragment queues hold conntrack references via pending SKBs that are not released before conntrack's netns exit hook runs, causing a deadlock due to reverse ordering of netns exit hooks (nf_defrag_ipv6 exits after conntrack).
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "The problem is that since conntrack depends on nf_defrag_ipv6, nf_defrag_ipv6 will load first. Since nf_defrag_ipv6 loads first its netns exit hooks run _after_ conntrack's netns exit hook." and "Scouring thru (de)fragmentation queues reveals skbs sitting around, holding conntrack references." The patch flushes all fragment queue SKBs in `fqdir_pre_exit()` to release conntrack references before conntrack cleanup runs.
